regime_context: The detector shows a broad but non-directional rotation (51% of eligible themes positive, absorption 0.32, no one-narrative dominance) with Memory/HBM & Storage as the clear leader on momentum score (2.34) and AI Infrastructure as a gap challenger (1.745). The absolute-trend gate is validated for drawdown control on this market (gate_helps true), but cross-sectional rank has ~0 forward edge, so any lean here is my judgment expressed as a falsifiable conditional, not extracted alpha.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the AI Semiconductors theme (rank 5, durability_bar 0.85, hurst_tag trend, breadth 0.917) closes its score gap to AI Infrastructure and challenges the AI-infra complex for leadership. I am watching for its rank score to move above 1.745 (the challenger score) with durability_bar staying above 0.8 — that handoff confirmation would retire this watch.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: This is the momentum leader with the widest score gap over the challenger (0.595), eligible under the trend gate, and not crowded (crowding_z 0.53). Durability is mixed/adequate (0.68) with solid breadth (0.75). The rank leg supports focus on this theme, and the trend-gate leg justifies staying with it for drawdown control. I lean with the persistent leader only because rotation is not directional and the gap is wide enough to suggest sustained leadership rather than a tipping point.
evidence: gate_helps true supports trend-following staying power
theses.dissent: Momentum rank has rank-IC ~0; the wide gap may simply mark a late-stage attention spike, and the leader is exactly where downside reversion risk concentrates if the AI-hardware narrative pauses.

falsifier.text: SMH underperforms SPY by 3% or more over the next 20 trading days

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: This is the confirmed challenger (rank 2, score 1.745), eligible with a comparable durability bar (0.66) and identical breadth (0.75), not crowded (crowding_z 0.82). It is the only theme close enough to challenge the leader while itself remaining in a positive trend. I lean with it as part of the same semiconductor/AI complex, supported by the trend-gate leg and the broad eligible-rotation structure.
evidence: named as rotation challenger with margin 0.595 to leader
theses.dissent: Its proxy is SMH, shared with the leader, so this is not a distinct directional call; the AI-infrastructure narrative may already be priced into the same semiconductor basket and offers little incremental diversification.

falsifier.text: AI Infrastructure tracked via SMH lags the Memory leader theme by more than 4% over the next 20 trading days

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity ranks third and is eligible with a strong durability bar (0.76) and high breadth (0.90), but it is flagged crowded (crowding_z 1.82, crowded true). Crowding is a size-down caution only, never a fade or short, but for a focus lens this is enough to lean away from adding here. I express this as avoid rather than underweight to respect the reflexivity guardrail against fading a strong leader.
theses.dissent: The crowding flag has no forward edge at the basket level and the theme has the best durability/breadth combination in the top ranks; avoiding it may sacrifice exposure to a legitimate high-quality trend.

falsifier.text: CIBR outperforms SPY by more than 5% over the next 20 trading days

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
